main.description: Internal authority callback that permanently deletes exactly one conversation Space generation. Requires the exact authority service JWT, DS audience, exact lxm, unique jti and a lifetime of at most 60 seconds. The authority must persist pending deletion and stop credential issuance before calling; only after success may it acknowledge deletion and durably notify registered repositories. Repeating the same exact generation with a fresh JWT is idempotent. No rebind or undelete exists.
